title: Listening to big bands; first job alone and the Chicago record
summary: Lewis enjoyed big bands, his first music job was solo, and he made a record in Chicago on Wabash Street.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Did you like to get out yourself and listen to those big bands in addition to playing? Oh, yeah.
Oh, yeah. I enjoyed it much. You listen to all kind of music? Oh, yeah. Some great days in them days, it ain't like it is now. I don't know. Fine times.
What was your first job playing music? Was it alone or with a band or what?

Alone. Mm-hmm. Alone, I played by myself. Alone. I went to Chicago and that's like that record you got to Vuk here. Mm-hmm. I made that in Chicago on Wabash Street there at the Brunswick Blake building. Mm-hmm. That's the building where they make pool tables and these pinball machines and things like that. Mm-hmm. That's the thing.
